steps.speaker: RAGHU (V.O.)
steps.text: The lights came back. All of them, all at once.

steps.speaker: RAGHU (V.O.)
steps.text: The CCTV kept recording. The last frame from CAM 4 shows me at the board.

steps.speaker: RAGHU (V.O.)
steps.text: And behind me, a small red light.

steps.speaker: RAGHU (V.O.)
steps.text: The register says I signed out at six. I never signed out.
